name: AI Learner
description: Press the AI button in the pause menu and a reinforcement-learning agent learns the level you are on.

training-speed.name: Training speed
training-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while the AI is learning.

rapid-speed.name: Rapid learning speed
rapid-speed.description: Game speed used while Learn Rapidly is on.

rapid-steps.name: Rapid steps per frame
rapid-steps.description: Game ticks simulated per drawn frame while Learn Rapidly is on. Higher is faster but heavier on the CPU.
